definitions.explanation: The quality of being correct and exact; freedom from errors or mistakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{データ|でーた}→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正確性|せいかくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To verify the accuracy of the data.

examples.japanese: {正確性|せいかくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正確性|せいかくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。

notes:
{正確性|せいかくせい} refers to the quality of being correct, exact, and free from errors. Common in technical, academic, and business contexts.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧ (accurate) + {性|せい} (quality/nature) = accuracy

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正確性|せいかくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}する→確保：13681_kakuho⟧: to ensure accuracy
- {正確性|せいかくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high/low accuracy
- {正確性|せいかくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack accuracy
- {正確性|せいかくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検証|けんしょう}する→検証：04792_kenshou⟧: to verify accuracy

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧: accurate (na-adjective)
- ⟦{精度|せいど}→精度：13787_seido⟧: precision (often interchangeable)
- ⟦{確実性|かくじつせい}→確実性：29133_kakujitsusei⟧: certainty, reliability
- ⟦{信頼性|しんらいせい}→信頼性：05572_shinraisei⟧: reliability, trustworthiness

USAGE:
Often used when discussing data, measurements, information quality, or work performance.
